text:
Nic Dowd built his name as Washington's shutdown center, and Vegas brought him in last season to do the same job. At 36 he's still killing minutes and throwing hits (50 of them in 21 games), but this season the job isn't getting done. He has no goals, 3 assists and just 6 shots on goal.

The five-on-five numbers are the real worry. With Dowd on the ice, Vegas has had 36.1% of the expected goals (the quality of chances); without him, the Golden Knights are more than 20 points better. Some bad luck is mixed in: Vegas has scored 4.7 fewer goals than its chances deserved while he's out there, and that tends to even out. But the underlying play matches last season, when Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level (-1.1 wins), with his team creating little with him on. His minutes have slipped to about 10 and a half over his last ten games while the team around him has mostly been winning. For a fourth-line center whose value is supposed to be keeping the puck out, the question is how long Vegas waits.
headline: Dowd's minutes are getting buried in Vegas
